shortDescription: Run commands via the MongoDB shell.

options.name: additional_args
options.description: Additional arguments to supply to the mongo command. Supply as key-value pairs. If the parameter is a valueless flag supply an empty string as the value.

options.name: atlas_auth
options.description: Authentication path intended for MongoDB Atlas Instances

options.name: auth_mechanism
options.description: Authentication type.

options.name: connection_options
options.description: Additional connection options. Supply as a list of dicts or strings containing key value pairs seperated with '='.

options.name: db
options.description: The database to run commands against

options.name: debug
options.description: show additional debug info.

options.name: eval
options.description: A MongoDB command to run.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to a file containing MongoDB commands.

options.name: idempotent
options.description: Provides a form of pseudo-idempotency to the module. We perform a hash calculation on the contents of the eval key or the file name provided in the file key. When the command is first execute a filed called <hash>.success will be created. The module will not rerun the command if this file exists and idempotent is set to true.

options.name: login_database
options.description: The database where login credentials are stored.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The host running MongoDB instance to login to.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate with. Required when I(login_user) is specified.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The MongoDB server port to login to.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The MongoDB user to login with. Required when I(login_password) is specified.

options.name: mongo_cmd
options.description: The MongoDB shell command. auto - Automatically detect which MongoDB shell command used. Use "mongosh" if available, else use "mongo" command. mongo - This should still work for most cases but you might have problems with json parsinf. Use transform_type of 'raw' is you encounter problems.

options.name: nodb
options.description: Specify a non-default encoding for output.

options.name: norc
options.description: Prevents the shell from sourcing and evaluating ~/.mongorc.js on start up.

options.name: omit
options.description: Parameter to omit from the command line. This should match the parameter name that the MongoDB shell accepts not the module name.

options.name: quiet
options.description: Silences output from the shell during the connection process..

options.name: split_char
options.description: Used by the split action in the transform stage.

options.name: ssl
options.description: Whether to use an SSL connection when connecting to the database.

options.name: ssl_ca_certs
options.description: The ssl_ca_certs option takes a path to a CA file.

options.name: ssl_cert_reqs
options.description: Specifies whether a certificate is required from the other side of the connection, and whether it will be validated if provided.

options.name: ssl_certfile
options.description: Present a client certificate using the ssl_certfile option.

options.name: ssl_crlfile
options.description: The ssl_crlfile option takes a path to a CRL file.

options.name: ssl_keyfile
options.description: Private key for the client certificate.

options.name: ssl_pem_passphrase
options.description: Passphrase to decrypt encrypted private keys.

options.name: strict_compatibility
options.description: Enforce strict requirements for pymongo and MongoDB software versions

options.name: stringify
options.description: Wraps the command in eval in JSON.stringify(<js cmd>) (mongo) or EJSON.stringify(<js cmd>) (mongosh). Useful for escaping documents that are returned in Extended JSON format. Automatically set to false when using mongo. Automatically set to true when using mongosh. Set explicitly to override automatic selection.

options.name: transform
options.description: Transform the output returned to the user. auto - Attempt to automatically decide the best tranformation. split - Split output on a character. json - parse as json. raw - Return the raw output.
